note: Multiple waterfront sites on a peninsula in Hamburg Mill Pond.  --AWH  GA state park near Mitchell on 225-acre Hamburg Lake (Little Ogeechee River); 1920s gristmill and museum. --Claude
summary: Park page and ReserveAmerica: confirmed 32 sites (30 + 2 host), water and electric with a dump station and hot showers (new bath house), year-round, ReserveAmerica booking. Changed fees $36-36 -> $32-36 (sites 01-03 are $32; Saturdays the same). Added 30/50-amp electric (50 at 08, 16, 27), no sewer at public sites, max 40 ft (29 public sites fit 23 ft; site 26 is 20 ft), 7 pull-throughs, the RA deep link. AWH note kept verbatim; my part trimmed of counts/hookups/booking. Lakefront stands on AWH's word; imagery shows the loop on the peninsula with pads at the shoreline.
